source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Use serum calcium alone because it directly measures bone mineral density.","B":"Use a routine hip radiograph because standard X-rays are the recommended population screening test.","C":"Screen with DXA bone mineral density, with or without a validated fracture-risk assessment.","D":"Wait until a fragility fracture occurs because screening before a fracture has no recommended role."}}
source_row.rationale: USPSTF recommends screening women age 65 years or older for osteoporosis; implementation uses DXA bone mineral density, with or without fracture-risk assessment.
